text: The Lattice Conductor moves Pulse around your camp; it makes none of its own. It has two jobs. A line of conductors carries a generator's reach across the camp, so a workshop can stand away from its power. And it fills the Pulse buffers of chalk-linked Resonance Totems, so a station beside a totem can spend that store. One craft makes four.

pages.title: Drawing the lattice
text: Totems are joined with **Ritual Chalk**. Right-click one totem, then another **less than 16 blocks** away. "Lattice link sealed" means it worked. Clicking the same totem twice cancels the pending mark. A stick of chalk is good for ten links or marks.
Linked totems form a network. Each totem's buffer holds **250 Pulse**, and any machine within 8 blocks of a totem can spend what is in it.
A chalk line carries voices too: a station counts the voice of a totem that is chalk-linked to one near it, as long as that partner stands less than 16 blocks from the station.

pages.title: Conductor lines
text: Conductors extend the zone without any chalk. Set them within 8 of each other, the first within 8 of a generator. A machine within 8 of any conductor on the line draws the generators, Pulse Cairns and totem buffers the line reaches.
The four from one craft are enough to cross a camp, and a line can run up to **64** conductors.
A redstone signal on a conductor cuts that block out of the line.

steps.caption: Two totems stand apart. Any voices will do.
Right-click the first totem with Ritual Chalk to mark it.
Then right-click the second, less than 16 blocks away: the lattice link is sealed.
Place the Conductor within 8 blocks of the totems, and a generator within 8 blocks of the Conductor.
Each second it fills the totem buffers, and a station beside the far totem can spend that Pulse.

pages.title: How it works
text: Every second the Conductor pulls up to **10 Pulse** from generators within 8 blocks, then from Pulse Cairns, and spreads it across the linked totems. Each [rank](machine_ranks) moves more.
Right-click it for a **25-Pulse** burst and a status line.
The [Ley Binding](world_rites) rite can join two distant totems for a while, and the Conductor routes along that thread as if they stood side by side.
The lattice carries Pulse, not goods. To move items over distance, use [relays](wireless_cargo).

pages.title: When it goes quiet
text: A lever or any redstone signal pauses totem filling and cuts that conductor out of the Pulse zone.
Clicking a conductor with no chalk link reports its Pulse zone, which needs no totems. "No network" on the Codex reading only means no totem buffers are linked yet; a network needs at least two.
"No Pulse" means there is nothing to move: bring a charged generator or a Pulse Cairn within 8 blocks of the Conductor.
"The lattice is full" is not a fault: every linked totem already holds its 250 Pulse. The Conductor starts again the moment a station spends some.
Crouch and right-click it with this book for the network size, the last Pulse pushed, and what is missing.
